constants.source: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)

inputs.requestIdNote: requestId = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(UTF-8(canonicalRequestPayload(request)))) per contracts-v1.md §7.1, computed with @mission-lab/contracts canonicalRequestPayload and Node crypto SHA-256 (test code only).

model.constantsSource: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)
model.units: SI: m, m/s, s, rad, m³/s²
model.time: t_s: elapsed SI seconds from the epoch (contracts-v1.md §2)

references: L2b: classical RK4 with Kahan summation, step halving (ref/rk.ts)
Validation: classical hyperbolic-anomaly perifocal propagation in 200-bit (ref/hyperbolic.ts)
Pre-maneuver state at m > 0: L2a in 200-bit (hp/hp-kepler.ts)
producedBy.independence: packages/astrodynamics and packages/simulation not read and not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value; JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0).

method.startState: Reference post-maneuver state: request initialState position, velocity fl(v⁻ + Δv_I,ref) with Δv_I,ref the 320-bit projection-form value rounded once (R12 form). The test starts L2b at the engine event state (position_m, velocityAfter_mps), which differs from this by the VT-12 level only.
method.sampling: Segment 1 of the contracts-v1.md §5.2 grid (ref/grid.ts): t_s from m to D; Δt = t − m. Output base 60 s.
method.perSampleConvention: §6.8 (review N4): arc-wide r_max, r_min, v_max, g_max, κ_E over the propagated arc [m, D]; x, r(t), Δt and the Δt-dependent terms per sample.

l2b.algorithm: Classical RK4 (p = 4), Kahan-compensated, fixed step; step halving h, h/2, h/4 (§9.2)

referenceAccuracy.l2b: E_RK per sample (§9.2, undivided d₂); every compared time asymptotic; E_RK ≤ 1e-10 r_max (target met, no loosening).
referenceAccuracy.validation: ‖L2b − hyperbolic 200-bit‖ per sample (measured_r_m, measured_v_mps), required ≤ 2E_RK (checked by datasets-d2.test.ts).

tolerance.record: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 4 (approved by the owner 2026-11-15) §6.8, §7 VT-16 (revision 4, P-3; validity gate 0.05 approved 2026-11-15)
tolerance.formula: ‖Δr‖ ≤ M·P_E,gen(Δt) + 2E_RK,r, ‖Δv‖ ≤ M·V_E,gen(Δt) + 2E_RK,v; first sample of the segment exact (R8)
tolerance.sample0: exact: first sample of the post-maneuver segment = event state (R8)
tolerance.layers: L2b (RK4), validated against a 200-bit hyperbolic-anomaly propagation
tolerance.assertionReason: Informative, not asserted: §6.8 (Scope) states that ε_t,gen assumes the engine solve ends at the noise level on hyperbolic arcs, which is not verified (open item O-12), and §12 O-12 places the extension of the O-1 check to these arcs "before the hyperbolic state comparison". O-12 is open, so the comparison is measured and reported only (ML-TASK-018 part D2 instruction; see conformance-run-3.md).
